title: tokyo beef storm
description: this hearty, comforting beef broth is infused with a rich, yeasty flavor from dashi powder and the savory umami of beef stock, perfect for a stormy japanese evening. traditionally a family recipe passed down through generations.

ingredients.name: beef bones
ingredients.notes: you can use beef neck bones or short ribs

ingredients.name: dashi powder
ingredients.notes: available at most asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.notes: optional, for added depth of flavor

instructions: heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
add the ginger and garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
add the beef bones and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
add the dashi powder and soy sauce (if using) and stir to combine.
add the sake and beef stock, and bring to a boil.
reduce the heat to low and simmer for at least 4 hours, or overnight.
strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot, discarding the solids.
ladle the hot broth into bowls and garnish with green onions.
